## Core conclusion
The strongest model is a transnational repertoire of locally rooted protests, not one global organization. Similar grievances and symbols coexist with differing local triggers and outcomes. Attribute casualty and arrest estimates, maintain time windows, and separate evidence from disputed interpretations.

## Limits
Purposive qualitative sample, not a global census. No original interviews, fieldwork, survey, controlled experiments or complete platform scrape. Not a peer-reviewed journal publication. Re-check fast-changing current claims before consequential use.
